summary: Describes an RTP payload format for Versatile Video Coding (VVC), published as ITU-T H.266 and ISO/IEC 23090-3. It allows packing one or more NAL units in a packet and splitting a NAL unit across several packets. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: Video must be chopped into pieces to fit in network packets. This is the recipe for packing and unpacking VVC video pieces so the video is put back together.

questions: how is vvc video sent over rtp
what is the rtp payload format for h.266
